System Monitor

A lightweight diagnostic utility built for real Nintendo GameCube hardware. Inspect system information, check controller and memory card connections, and monitor expansion port presence—all from your console.

A straightforward, two-page interface focused on the hardware information and device connections that matter when testing a console.

System diagnostics
